cohorts.description: Named datasets this pipeline config can run on, so the command line says which one a run uses instead of it depending on a pointer inside this file. Each value is a mapping with a required `samples:` (sample sheet path) and an optional `output_dir:`. Select with --cohort; `default_cohort:` is used when the flag is omitted. Omit this block entirely to keep the old behaviour, where `configs.samples` alone selects the dataset.

default_cohort.description: Cohort used when --cohort is not given. Without it, a config that declares cohorts REQUIRES the flag -- deliberately, so nothing silently picks a dataset.

configs.description: Paths to the sub-configs this stage reads.

samples.description: Sample sheet. Optional only when `cohorts:` is declared, in which case the selected cohort supplies it.

output_dir.description: Mapping stage output root. No default -- a site-specific data location with no sensible fallback (main.py raises without it).

tmp_dir.description: Scratch root for index builds. Falls back to $TMPDIR then the system temp dir. piscem index builds are unreliable on Lustre.

cellbender.description: CellBender runs from its own conda env as a subprocess.

env.description: Conda PREFIX (the directory containing bin/), not the binary. Overridable with $CELLBENDER_ENV.

doublets.description: Per-sample doublet detection (scvi-tools SOLO). Runs from its own conda env as a subprocess, for the same reason CellBender does: scvi-tools does not support the pandas 3.x the mapping stage is on. Whether its calls remove cells is set by `solo.mode` in filter_config.yaml, not here.

env.description: Conda PREFIX (the directory containing bin/), not the binary. Overridable with $DOUBLET_ENV. Must have scvi-tools installed.

use_cuda.description: Train on GPU. Mapping already needs a GPU node for CellBender, so this costs no extra infrastructure.

max_epochs.description: scVI training epochs. Left unset, scvi-tools picks a cell-count-dependent default.

n_epochs_kl_warmup.description: KL warmup CEILING in epochs for the throwaway scVI model (into plan_kwargs). SingleCellIntegrate scales warmup to half the effective max_epochs and clamps this value down if it would not complete, so warmup always finishes; left unset it is derived the same way. scvi's own default (400) never completes on these small models and drove the 100%-doublet failure (scvi-tools #507). Applies to the final fit and, when tune is on, the tuning trials.

hvg_n_top_genes.description: HVGs the model is trained on. Selected on the mapping side with scanpy so the temp exchange file stays small.

layer.description: Layer the model trains on. scVI's likelihood is defined on counts, so "raw_counts" (integers) rather than CellBender-corrected floats.

min_cells.description: Fewest QC-passed cells SOLO will run on (default 200). A technical floor, not a quality judgement, so falling below it is a recorded skip rather than the advisory downgrade sample_quality applies. Below ~10 cells scvi-tools has no validation split at all and autotune dies in ray; well above that the model still fails to converge and calls ~100% of cells doublets.

max_plausible_rate.description: Doublet rate above which the fitted model is judged unconverged (default 0.5): its calls are downgraded to advisory and flagged in the report. Real 10x rates run ~1-30%.

tune.description: Autotune hyperparameters. Runs PER SAMPLE, so a 40-sample cohort means 40 tuning jobs; off by default.

timeout.description: Seconds before the worker subprocess is killed.

scrublet.description: Scrublet, the second per-sample doublet caller (scanpy). Runs in-process (CPU, no torch/GPU/subprocess) so it also covers samples SOLO skips; its calls form the SOLO+Scrublet consensus. Whether each of SOLO/Scrublet/consensus removes cells is set per-method by mode: in filter_config.yaml, not here.

expected_doublet_rate.description: Scrublet's prior on the simulated doublet fraction (default 0.06).

n_prin_comps.description: PCA components for Scrublet's kNN. Auto-reduced below the cell count on small samples.

layer.description: Counts layer Scrublet simulates from. Unset follows doublets.layer. All genes are used -- Scrublet does its own gene-variability selection.

min_cells.description: Fewest QC-passed cells Scrublet runs on (default 50). Below it is a recorded skip; lower than SOLO's floor since Scrublet has no validation split.
